Name: Acts 2-4 (draft)
Source: Act 2: order from the Maxroll PoE2 campaign guide (updated 2026-06-02). Act 3: drafted 2026-10-11 from the known campaign order and Radar's G3 places, fixed live with the player through the feedback key. Act 4: 2026-10-12 from the game's own quest states (Main and Follow read each state's text as an objective: objective-types.json, docs/objective-types.md) and a speedrun research pass (Domistae 0.5.5, poe2db, Maxroll), island order for 100%. Places are Radar targets.json names.

Quests.Label: Speak to Makoru at the ship: hand her the Boat Charter
Quests.Note: Verified live 2026-10-12: 52 = 'Speak to Makoru to hire her ship.' Since 0.5.5c the islands stay locked until the charter is handed to her

Quests.Label: Sail to Whakapanu Island (Makoru): map piece, Shark Fin, Diamora
Quests.Note: 100% island order (research): Whakapanu first (Torn Map Piece, the Great White One's Shark Fin, Diamora in the Singing Caverns). Ends when G4_3_2SirenBossKilled is set

Quests.Label: Sail to Shrike Island (Makoru): map piece, the Scourge of the Skies
Sail to the Abandoned Prison (Makoru): Goddess of Justice, the Prisoner
Sail to the Isle of Kin (Makoru): map piece, Krutog
Sail to the Eye of Hinekora (Makoru): Matiki's trial, +5% mana, tattoos
Quests.Note: Research: freeing Matiki (caged by one of the four island bosses, random per league) opens the Eye. The Karui quests' own texts lead once there (Follow)

Quests.Label: Sail to Kedge Bay (Makoru): map piece, Journey's End (+2 weapon set points)
Journey's End: Captain Hartlin (the Verisium Ingots)
Quests.Note: Verified live 2026-10-12: 15 = 'Explore Journey's End.', 14 = 'Summon Tujen.', 13 = 'Speak to Tujen.', 12 = 'Find Captain Hartlin.', 11 = 'Captain Hartlin has ... become an undead horror. Slay him', 10 = '... found the Verisium Ingots ... Pick them up.' An open objective for the area you are in keeps Journey's End's steps (and these texts, Follow) leading instead of sending the player to the story's next island

Quests.Label: Sail to Plunder's Point (Makoru): the Verisium Anvil
Sail to Arastas (Makoru)
Venom Crypts: search the corpse (Venom Vial)
Quests.Note: Verified live 2026-10-11: 9 = 'Search for the source of their poison' (town), 8 = 'Explore The Venom Crypts' (on entering), 7 = 'You have discovered a corpse. Search it.' (near it, vial not taken yet), 6 = 'Pick up the Corpse-snake Venom' (on the ground, Metadata/Items/QuestItems/Gallows/Act3/SnakeLadyPotion: the quest-item rule leads to it). The corpse is Metadata/Chests/QuestChests/SnakePit/SnakeLadyPotionChest in the boss room

Quests.Label: Enter Jiquani's Machinarium
Quests.Note: Verified live 2026-10-11: 49 = 'You have defeated the Machinarium's guardian chimera. Enter the facility.' Xyclucian drops the Chimeral Inscribed Ultimatum (Metadata/Items/QuestItems/UltimatumKeyQuest): the quest-item rule leads to it first

Quests.Label: Xyclucian, the Chimera (Deadly Nest)
Quests.Note: Verified live 2026-10-11: 50 = 'A massive beast seems to be guarding the entrance to the Machinarium. Defeat it.' (set in the Chimeral Wetlands)

Quests.Label: The Matlan Waterways: drain the area
Quests.Note: Verified live 2026-10-11: 34 = 'You have gained access to The Matlan Waterways. Enter the area, find the control mechanisms and drain the area.' Area G3_2_2|G3_3 so the Jungle Ruins steps (Silverfist) still run; G3_2_2 leads to the Waterways Lever

Quests.Label: Activate the Stone Altar with the Large Soul Core
Quests.Note: Verified live 2026-10-11: 35 = 'You have retrieved the large Soul Core. Return to Jungle Ruins and activate the Stone Altar to gain passage to The Matlan Waterways'. The altar is Metadata/Terrain/Gallows/Act3/3_2_1/Objects/WaterwaysUnlockControl ('Stone Altar') next to the Jungle Ruins waypoint. From the Sanctum: portal, then the waypoint

Quests.Label: Pick up the Large Soul Core
Quests.Note: Verified live 2026-10-11: 36 = 'You have defeated Zicoatl ... Pick up the Large Soul Core'

Quests.Label: Click the Large Soul Core (summons Zicoatl)
Quests.Note: Verified live 2026-10-11: 38 = 'The Large Soul Core near Alva is now retrievable. Collect it.' (after both reactors, and again after dying to Zicoatl). The core is 3_6_2/Objects/BossPowerGem ('Large Soul Core', powered=1,fight_ready=2); Zicoatl's dormant statue stands on it

Quests.Label: Place the Soul Core in the Stone Altar
Quests.Note: Verified live 2026-10-11: 44 = 'You have found a small Soul Core. Take it to the Stone Altar to proceed deeper into the ruin.' Cores are ground items Metadata/Items/QuestItems/Gallows/Act3/VaalKeyGem (the quest-item rule leads to them); altars are 3_6_1/Objects/KeyPedestal_Entrance|Exit|Boss|Landmark, each next to a KeyDoor

Quests.Label: Explore for the next Soul Core
Quests.Note: Verified live 2026-10-11: 48 = 'found an ancient Vaal facility, search for a large Soul Core' (on entering), 47/46 = stone altar / ask Alva (the user skips Alva), 43 = 'found a small Soul Core and opened the door ... proceed deeper'. The area steps explore toward the Sanctum; each core takes over when it loads

Quests.Label: Infested Barrens: on to the Chimeral Wetlands
Quests.Note: Verified live 2026-10-11: 56 = 'Find The Matlan Waterways' (town); 55 = 'discovered a stone altar ... control mechanism for a canal; summon Alva' (Jungle Ruins). The waterways stay flooded until Jiquani's Sanctum, so the Barrens steps go to the Chimeral Wetlands first

Quests.Label: Light the Ancient Seals (3), then the Clasped Entry
Quests.Note: Verified live 2026-10-10: state 6 = 'Enter the Titan Grotto at the Clasped Entry' (the G2_6 steps handle the seals and the entry)

Quests.Label: Pick up the Essence of Water
Quests.Note: Verified live 2026-10-10: state 3 = 'Pick up the Essence of Water'; it drops by the goddess (~(2752,832)) as a WorldItem whose item is Metadata/Items/QuestItems/Gallows/Act2/EssenceOfTheWaterGod

Quests.Label: Wait while the Water Goddess burns
Quests.Note: Unverified (2026-10-10, from the user): between using the cinders (5) and the essence (3) you wait for her to die; the route stays on her instead of the island fallback

Quests.Label: Use the Everburning Cinders on the Water Goddess
Quests.Note: Verified live 2026-10-10: state 5 = 'Use the nearby Everburning Cinders to grant her request'. WaterGoddess_Fire ('Everburning Cinders', ~(2737,874)) is clickable first; WaterGoddess_BurnInteract ('Ignite the Goddess', ~(2737,820)) is untargetable until then

Quests.Label: Speak with the Water Goddess
Quests.Note: Verified live 2026-10-10: state 6 = 'There is a Water Goddess lying in a shrine at the heart of Keth'; after the Heart of Keth boss, WaterGoddessUnnamed stands south of the arena (~(2737,818)) past the BossDoor; the Heart of Keth (boss transition) is the fallback until she is loaded

Quests.Label: Search for access to Keth
Quests.Note: Verified live 2026-10-10: state 10 = 'Search for access to Keth'

Quests.Label: Retrace Orbala's path: the Horn of the Vastiri (Mastodon Badlands)
Quests.Note: Verified live 2026-10-10: state 18 = 'only recreating the Horn of the Vastiri will dispel the sandstorm'. Listed before the caravan return: the user does the horn first, then talks to Zarka. Area steps lead on to the Bone Pits

Quests.Label: Return to the Ardura Caravan
Quests.Note: Verified live 2026-10-10: state 2 = 'You have burned the Water Goddess alive at her request. Return to the Ardura Caravan.' (set when the Essence of Water is picked up)

Use.Label: Use The Flame Core (10% Fire Res)
Use.Note: Verified live 2026-10-11: Blackjaw (The Oubliette, Jiquani's Machinarium) drops it; Metadata/Items/QuestItems/Gallows/Act3/SoulCoreConsumable in the main inventory until right-clicked

G4_3_1.Label: Torn Map Piece (Petrified Pirate, for Plunder's Point)
G4_3_1.Note: Research 2026-10-12: 1 of the 4 Torn Map Pieces Makoru needs for Plunder's Point (Verisium Anvil). Unverified spot: Radar's row is Name '*'

G4_3_1.Label: The Great White One: its Shark Fin (Kaimana's permanent blessing)
G4_3_1.Note: Research: Tribal Medicine; the fin is a quest item (the quest-item rule leads to it once dropped). Kaimana takes it in Ngakanu or on the Kingsmarch docks

G4_3_1.Label: Crabshell Cavern: rare crab (T4 Support Gem)

G4_3_2.Label: Beckoning Clam: the Humming Pearl (Rog trades it for an amulet)
G4_3_2.Note: Research: survive the clam's ambush for the Humming Pearl (quest item), give it to Rog for a Pearlescent Amulet

G4_3_2.Label: Diamora, Song of Death (weapon piece or Matiki)
G4_3_2.Note: Research: bring a Thawing Charm. Drops a weapon piece (the Hooded One gathers it) or guards Matiki in a cage (random per league)

G4_7.Label: The Scourge of the Skies (weapon piece or Matiki)

G4_5_1.Label: Chapel: Goddess of Justice (30% flask recovery; needs the Chapel Key)
G4_5_1.Note: Research: the Chapel Key drops from monsters here; kill Forael, the Soulkeeper, then click the Goddess of Justice (life or mana flask recovery, changeable)

G4_5_2.Label: Open the Fortified Door: the Prisoner (fire the ballista when he kneels)

G4_1_1.Label: The Blind Beast (Blank Greater Rune for Dannig)
G4_1_1.Note: Research: 0.3 gave +2 weapon set points here; 0.5.x drops a Blank Greater Rune (Dannig turns it into a Greater Rune of your choice)

G4_1_2.Target: radar:2 Rares - Rare Ring matching last killed golem
G4_1_2.Label: Magma Twins (rare ring)
Krutog, Lord of Kin (weapon piece or Matiki)

G4_4_1.Label: Silent Halls: pay respects at the altar (+5% maximum Mana)
G4_4_1.Note: Research: behind a checkpoint near the end; then talk to Navali

G4_4_2.Label: The three Tests: a Blank Tattoo each (+5 attribute or +5% resistance)
G4_4_2.Note: Research: Tawhoa (Dex / Lightning), Tasalio (Int / Cold), Ngamahu (Str / Fire); each tattoo goes to the Hinekora Totem or Navali for a permanent choice. The tattoo quests' own texts lead once they start

G4_4_2.Label: Yama the White: the Silver Coin

G4_2_2.Label: Captain Hartlin: the Verisium Ingots (to Dannig)

G4_11_1b.Label: Kaimana (Shark Fin: a permanent blessing)
G4_11_1b.Note: Research: the medicine woman's hut; with the Shark Fin, Tribal Medicine's own text leads to her

G4_11_2.Label: Tavakai, the Chieftain (he flees at half life: follow him)

G3_3.Label: Mighty Silverfist (+2 Passive)
G3_3.Note: Verified live 2026-10-11: Radar's 'Monkeee' row is Silverfist's spot (one step, not two); his monster is MonkeyChiefJungle, so the step ends on his kill and the route hides while you fight him

G3_2_1.Label: Side quest: The Azak Bog (Ignagduk, +30 Spirit)

G3_6_1.Label: Place the Soul Core in the Stone Altar
G3_6_1.Note: Verified live 2026-10-11: cores are VaalKeyGem<n> in MainInventory once picked up; the quest stays at 43 while you carry the second one, so the inventory decides. Used altars turn untargetable (KeyPedestal_Entrance)

G3_6_1.Label: The Oubliette: Blackjaw (10% Fire Res)
G3_6_1.Note: Verified live 2026-10-11: Radar's Oubliette row is the boss-room door tile; Blackjaw (BlackJaw@37) stands ~145 cells past it (the room icon ~(2012,455)) and drops The Flame Core (see Use). The user: not the boss himself as the target (marker on him while fighting, then on his body)

G3_6_1.Label: Keep exploring: the next Soul Core shows when it loads

G3_6_2.Label: Click the reactor to insert the Medium Soul Core
G3_6_2.Note: Verified live 2026-10-11: each reactor's switch is MachinariumGeneratorButton ('Generator', IngameIcon), activate=0 and targetable until powered (one at ~(1506,1138), the other ~(402,1138)). Medium Soul Cores on the ground come first through the quest-item rule. Radar's 'Generator' row named only one of them

G3_6_2.Label: Zicoatl, Warden of the Core
G3_6_2.Note: Verified live 2026-10-11: Radar's Boss row is the arena's wall tiles (BossWall01.tdt), fine for getting there; the route hides during the fight (unique boss near) and the step ends when Zicoatl (Metadata/Monsters/VaalBossStatue/VaalStatueBoss, dead copies loaded beside him) is dead. Quest 37 = defeat Zicoatl for the Large Soul Core, 38 = the Large Soul Core near Alva is retrievable

G3_8.Label: The Molten Vault (Mektul, reforging bench)
G3_8.Note: Verified live 2026-10-11: QuestFlag G3_9VaalForgeMasterKilled is set once Mektul is dead; without it the step sent the player back after RaidTheTreasureVault was done

G3_12.Label: Up the Temple of Kopec: Ketzuli at the top

G2_6.Label: Take the seal's portal
G2_6.Note: Verified live 2026-10-10: clicking TitanValley_SwitchN (up the stairs) makes AncientSealNPortal targetable with active=1, ~90 cells from the switch on the same TitanQuest tile (a seal platform is ~185 cells wide, so no Within); the portal returns you to the valley

G2_6.Label: Light the Ancient Seal (click it, up the stairs)
G2_6.Note: The seal itself: Metadata/QuestObjects/Four_Act2/TitanValley_SwitchN, IngameIcon 'Ancient Seal'; active=1 and untargetable once lit. Loaded only near the platform, so the tile step below leads you there first

G2_6.Label: Go to the next Ancient Seal
G2_6.Note: Radar's TitanQuest01/02/03.tdt platforms; one whose switch was seen lit (loaded now or earlier this visit) is dropped. A platform never visited counts as unlit. All three seal steps end once AncientSeal1/2/3Portal have all been seen active=1 (2026-10-10: the switches were never seen lit, so ExcludeNear alone kept sending you to a lit seal)

G2_6.Label: The Titan Grotto (Clasped Entry): walk up, it animates open, go in
G2_6.Note: Verified live 2026-10-10: the G2_7 transition is AreaTransition_Animate in the valley centre (CentreTile_Larger.tdt, ~(680,1016)), next to TitanValley_TitanHands; the old titan_valley_boss_01 tile guess was wrong
